opportunities.point: Goldiam targets double-digit overall growth in FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We hope for and we are looking forward to build towards a very positive growth, double-digit growth in FY '27 on an overall basis." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Goldiam is targeting an exit revenue of about INR 7 crores per month for its ORIGEM business in FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: ORIGEM doubled its store count to 24 operational stores across 12 cities between January 2026 and May 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "From January 2026 till now, ORIGEM, Goldiam's India retail lab-grown diamond jewelry brand has doubled its store count, now having 24 operational stores across 12 cities." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Opening an ORIGEM store costs approximately INR 3.5 crores, which includes INR 2.5 crores of inventory investment.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So per store, approximately it costs INR3.5 crores to open 1 store, INR2.5 crores of which is inventory investment needed in gold, diamond making charges all put together." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that demand scenario continues to look positive, particularly in lab-grown diamond studded jewelry.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "So yes, the demand scenario continues to look positive, specifically in the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Retailers are moving down in gold caratage to mitigate higher raw material costs.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "In general, we see our retailers in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs, specifically in gold, moving down in Kt." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Goldiam's order book position as of March 31, 2026, was approximately INR 2,000 million.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Goldiam's order book position as on March 31, 2026, was at about INR2,000 million." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Goldiam operates about 30 diamond growing machines at its SEZ facility.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "So we have about 30 machines within the facility in SEZ that are operating nonstop." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores to be operational by September 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Foreign institutions have been building a position.

threats.point: Goldiam faced business disruptions related to tariffs, Middle East war, and gold price volatility during FY26.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite the business disruptions related to tariffs, Middle East war, volatility in gold prices, Goldiam ended FY2026 with a tremendously impressive 27.5% consolidated revenue increase at INR1,212.3 million and a robust 45.7% increase in consolidated PAT at..." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The increase in Indian custom duty on gold to 15% will not materially impact Goldiam's operations or profitability.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Here, I would like you to note that Goldiam is tariff agnostic and the recent increase in custom duty in India on gold to 15% will not have any material impact on Goldiam's operations, financial performance or profitability." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: ORIGEM recorded an EBITDA level loss of about INR 15 crores for FY26.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "I was saying that I can share that the overall EBITDA level loss at ORIGEM's level was about INR15 crores for the full fiscal year." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Dec) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Weaknesses dominate the evidence (S26/W28/O27/T23), led by 'Operating cash flow is negative while the company books a profit', and the positives on record do not currently outweigh them.
